description: Land Title Settlement Department - Bebiyawewa, Medirigiriya D/S Division, Polonnaruwa  District   -  Cad Map No. 120060
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including their registration details, ownership status (all owned by "The State"), and land particulars such as parcel numbers, extents, and locations. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification.
